assign.outcome:
**Fixed: a failed font fetch no longer blanks the site.** Root cause: `Font.load()` awaited `FontFace.load()` unguarded (`core/App/Font.js`) — a rejected fetch propagated through `App.loaded()`'s `Promise.all` and out of `App.load()` (`App.js`'s final `await this.loaded()` sits outside its own try/catch), landing in `instantiate()`'s catch, which runs `error()` but never reaches `inject()` — so `.app` is built and never appended, and the page renders blank white.

Fix: `Font.js`'s `load()` now wraps `FontFace.load()` in try/catch — one `console.warn` naming the font and its url, skip `document.fonts.add()`, resolve instead of reject. No `App.js` edit was needed.

![before](before.jpg) blank white, fonts blocked, pre-fix
![after](after.jpg) readable in the fallback font, fonts blocked, post-fix — one warn per font, zero page errors
![normal](normal.jpg) fonts allowed, post-fix — unchanged from before the edit, Material Icons glyphs render

Docs corrected to match reality: the `Font.js` comment, `doc/fonts.md`'s "unresolved part" paragraph, and `doc/file/Font.js.md` improvement #1 — the three places that claimed a silent fallback.

Left alone: vendoring the fonts (the owner's trade, unchanged) and `framework.css` (untouched, per fence).
